requirements.label: Domain arcade profile is exported
requirements.passCondition: App exports ARCADE_MODE_ENABLED and ARCADE_CONVERSION_PROFILE from src/domain/arcade.ts and re-exports via src/domain/index.ts.

requirements.label: Arcade runtime loop is implemented
requirements.passCondition: App includes an arcade loop with timer pressure and deterministic fail/continue state transitions.

requirements.label: Arcade HUD and session feedback are wired
requirements.passCondition: UI surfaces score/combo/time HUD and end-of-run summary with restart and replay actions.

requirements.label: Fast-path controls are mapped
requirements.passCondition: Arcade mode supports keyboard navigation and action mappings (WASD plus arrow keys) without breaking existing controls.

requirements.label: Quality gates pass for conversion
requirements.passCondition: Converted app passes pnpm check, pnpm test, and pnpm validate with no new architecture or compliance violations.

requirements.label: Conversion is production-ready
requirements.passCondition: All arcade conversion requirements are PASS and app status is marked converted.
